name: e-commerce-platform
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform with admin dashboard, customer frontend, and scalable backend

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd admin && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install && cd ../shared && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:admin && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:admin && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
